title: X-LAB RS9 complete-bike specification
notes: Official mainland specification for the Dura-Ace R9270 / Vision Metron 45 SL complete bike. It states 7.0 kg without pedals in size L, Toray T1100 carbon, Dura-Ace Di2 2x12 with 52/36T and 11-34T, Shimano BB-R9100, Maxxis HYPR ZK 700x28C tires, five-size geometry and a 100 kg maximum load.
